concerns.text: The Constitution (Principle III – Data Hygiene) requires that every dataset file be checksummed and the checksum recorded. No task in the current list creates or records these checksums for raw or processed data files.

The Constitution (Principle IV – Single Source of Truth) mandates that each figure, statistic, or interpretation trace back to a unique data row and code block. No task currently establishes or records this provenance linkage.

The Constitution (Principle V – Versioning Discipline) requires content‑hash tracking for all project artifacts. There is no task that generates or records these hashes for code, data, or output artifacts.
